cover_letter.objective: Results-driven AI and Full Stack Developer with over 4 years of experience architecting end-to-end web applications, generative AI workflows, and machine learning integrations. Proven expertise in building token-efficient LLM pipelines, intelligent RAG agents, and secure blockchain networks. Passionate about bridging the gap between advanced data science and scalable production engineering to deliver high-impact enterprise solutions.

highlights: Architected an intelligent document processing pipeline utilizing LangGraph and LlamaIndex workflows to ingest, parse, and structure complex financial contracts and PDFs.
Integrated OpenAI APIs to drive the NLP engine, enabling the automated extraction of critical financial data, transaction details, and contextual insights from unstructured text.
Engineered a highly accurate Personally Identifiable Information (PII) detection system using AI to dynamically identify sensitive entities across varied document layouts.
Developed robust visual redaction workflows utilizing PyMuPDF (fitz) and PyPDF to permanently scrub PII prior to data storage, ensuring strict data privacy and compliance.
Designed token-efficient agentic workflows by leveraging Knowledge Graphs and optimizing LlamaIndex routing, significantly reducing LLM API latency and operational costs.
Implemented context-aware highlighting mechanisms that visually isolate and annotate key transaction data directly within the processed PDFs for downstream human review.
Orchestrated complex state machines using LangGraph's conditional edges to handle multi-step document validation, chunking, and extraction processes dynamically.
Built resilient data ingestion infrastructure capable of transforming and loading extracted, unstructured financial contexts into normalized relational database schemas.
Improved extraction fidelity by designing custom prompting strategies and evaluation loops tailored specifically to complex financial nomenclature and transaction histories.
Deployed the end-to-end NLP pipeline within a highly available enterprise architecture, drastically reducing the manual overhead required for financial document analysis.
Developed a highly capable AI agent on the Endor platform, designed to automate IT support, user onboarding, and access request workflows through a conversational interface.
Implemented dynamic tool-calling and discovery functionality, empowering the AI agent to autonomously interface with and execute actions across integrated enterprise platforms like Box and Quip.
Designed a comprehensive Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) architecture, guaranteeing that the chatbot restricts tool execution and data visibility strictly to authorized personnel.
Engineered an intelligent Text-to-SQL Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) engine that dynamically reads database schemas to construct, optimize, and execute SQL queries based on user prompts.
Integrated enterprise ticketing systems directly with the agentic workflow, enabling zero-touch automation for raising, tracking, and resolving IT and HR service requests.
Built automated onboarding sequences where the chatbot autonomously provisions user accounts, verifies permissions, and allocates cross-platform access based on conversational inputs.
Utilized advanced custom agent executors to orchestrate complex, multi-step tool interactions, implementing intelligent fallback mechanisms for enhanced system reliability.
Secured all backend integrations and API connections, ensuring that automated operations—such as document retrieval and ticket generation—adhered to stringent enterprise security protocols.
Created self-healing database query mechanisms where the agent iteratively refines its SQL syntax against schema constraints if initial data retrieval attempts fail.
Delivered a streamlined user experience that unified disparate enterprise applications into a single, intelligent chat interface, significantly reducing manual administrative bottlenecks.

experience.role: Full Stack & Machine Learning Developer (Client: Bank of America)
highlights: Spearheaded the development of an internal workplace application for Bank of America as a Full Stack React and Java developer focused on customer document generation.
Engineered a robust unstructured data processing pipeline designed to ingest, parse, and analyze varied banking transaction documents at scale.
Designed advanced Regex-based extraction algorithms to accurately isolate, validate, and pull critical financial information from highly unstructured text formats.
Built the backend data ingestion architecture using Java to reliably transform parsed textual data and load it into structured relational database tables.
Developed a rigorous evaluation framework to continuously benchmark extraction accuracy, allowing for iterative refinement of parsing logic and pattern matching.
Implemented automated data validation and cleaning layers to ensure zero data corruption during the unstructured-to-structured transformation phase.
Optimized high-throughput document processing services, significantly reducing the manual overhead previously required for transaction logging and reporting.
Architected resilient database schemas optimized for fast querying and retrieval of massive volumes of extracted transactional data.
Ensured strict data fidelity and compliance with internal banking standards throughout the end-to-end document lifecycle.
Served as a Full Stack React and Java developer focused on banking product recommendations.
Designed and deployed a predictive Artificial Neural Network (ANN) deep learning model to recommend highly tailored financial products based on complex customer activity sequences.
Handled end-to-end full-stack responsibilities, seamlessly integrating the machine learning recommendation engine into the core enterprise workplace portal.
Engineered robust backend data pipelines to continuously track, aggregate, and process multi-channel customer activities and interaction histories.
Architected the parameterization layer in the backend, actively calculating, transforming, and formatting raw transactional data into optimized feature sets for the neural network.
Implemented sophisticated data encoding strategies, converting varied categorical and numerical customer parameters into tensor-ready formats for model inference.
Developed a real-time recommendation API that feeds the ANN's predictive outputs directly to the React front-end, empowering banking associates with actionable cross-sell suggestions.
Bridged the gap between data science and production engineering, ensuring the complex deep learning architecture ran securely within a highly available enterprise environment.
Optimized backend computational efficiency to handle high-velocity data processing, ensuring low-latency product recommendations even under heavy user load.
Drove measurable improvements in targeted product visibility by surfacing data-driven insights that directly aligned with individual customer financial profiles.

experience.role: Full Stack & Blockchain Developer (Client: Rainforest Foundation)
highlights: Architected and delivered a full-stack, decentralized web application for the Rainforest Foundation to facilitate transparent global charitable giving.
Designed, deployed, and maintained a production-grade Hyperledger Fabric blockchain network to record charitable transactions on an immutable, decentralized ledger.
Authored and deployed custom chaincode (smart contracts) to govern donation processing logic and ensure absolute data integrity across all network nodes.
Integrated the PayPal Advanced payment gateway using hosted fields, enabling secure fiat transactions seamlessly through the front-end application.
Engineered the synchronization bridge between the traditional React/Java application layer and the decentralized Hyperledger network, optimizing for low-latency transaction processing.
Implemented rigorous security protocols, combining PayPal's hosted field tokenization with Fabric's private chaincode features to protect sensitive donor financial data.
Developed comprehensive access control mechanisms within the chaincode to ensure that only authorized network participants could validate and commit transactions to the ledger.
Managed the end-to-end chaincode lifecycle (packaging, installing, approving, and committing) to facilitate seamless, zero-downtime upgrades of the blockchain business logic.
Successfully transitioned from an intensive initial technical training cohort (Dec 2021 – Mar 2022) directly into high-impact contributions on the core engineering team.
Established verifiable, auditable transaction trails on the blockchain, providing donors with transparent proof of how and where their funds were allocated.
